items.html: And afterwards, when the first Shabbat came, the Nukva returned to be corrected in all the six aspects mentioned above, and the sixth aspect was completed — that she returned with him face to face, in all the measure of his stature, except the aspect of Keter alone, which was greater than her Keter, being the aspect higher than all of them and higher than her. Therefore she still needed to receive from Ima, through him; and then they did not use one crown, which is the most exalted aspect of all, as above.
